sections.title: 一、听力理解 (第一段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第一段对话,完成第1、2小题。

audio.text:
Dad: Emma, how was your trip to London?
Emma: Great! Dad. But one thing was funny. I took a taxi. I opened the front door and got in. The driver said, "In London, we usually sit in the back."
Dad: So what did you do?
Emma: I sat in the back. Now I know!
Dad: Yes, different places have different ways.
Emma: I think these differences make travelling fun.
Dad: I think so, too.

questions.translation: 在伦敦打车时让艾玛感到惊讶的是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Emma: I opened the front door and got in. The driver said, "In London, we usually sit in the back."' 可知艾玛一开始不知道在伦敦应该坐在后座，故选 C。
questions.prompt: What surprised Emma when she took a taxi in London?
options: She didn't know where to sit.

questions.translation: 谁认为文化差异让旅行更有趣？
questions.explanation: 听力原文中艾玛说 'I think these differences make travelling fun.'，爸爸回答 'I think so, too.'，两人都这么认为，故选 C。
questions.prompt: Who thinks cultural differences make travelling fun?

sections.title: 二、听力理解 (第二段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第二段对话,完成第3、4、5小题。

audio.text:
Alex: Lily, did you enjoy your trip to London?
Lily: Yes, it was amazing! We saw so many famous places.
Alex: Really? What did you see?
Lily: We saw Big Ben and Buckingham Palace. We also rode a double-decker bus!
Alex: Sounds fun! Did you try any local food?
Lily: Yes, we had fish and chips. It was delicious!
Alex: That's great. Travelling is a good way to learn about the world.
Lily: I agree. I love seeing new things.

questions.translation: 莉莉在伦敦乘坐了什么交通工具？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Lily: We also rode a double-decker bus!' 可知她乘坐了双层巴士，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What did Lily ride in London?

questions.translation: 莉莉在伦敦吃了什么食物？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Lily: Yes, we had fish and chips. It was delicious!' 可知吃了炸鱼薯条，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What did Lily eat in London?

questions.translation: 莉莉对旅行有什么看法？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Alex: Travelling is a good way to learn about the world. Lily: I agree. I love seeing new things.' 可知她认为旅行是学习新事物的好方式，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What does Lily think about travelling?
options: It's a good way to eat delicious food.
It's a good way to learn new things.
It's a good way to spend money.

sections.title: 三、国别匹配 (Get ready & Start up)
sections.instruction: 读单词和短语, 将它们匹配到所属的国家。

questions.prompt: A. the Eiffel Tower (埃菲尔铁塔)
questions.translation: 埃菲尔铁塔位于法国巴黎。
questions.explanation: the Eiffel Tower 是法国著名的地标建筑，属于 France。

questions.prompt: B. spaghetti (意大利面)
questions.translation: 意大利面是意大利的传统美食。
questions.explanation: spaghetti 是意大利标志性美食，属于 Italy。

questions.prompt: C. Canadian Rockies (加拿大落基山脉)
questions.translation: 落基山脉是加拿大的著名自然奇观。
questions.explanation: Canadian Rockies 位于加拿大，属于 Canada。

questions.prompt: D. maple leaf (枫叶)
questions.translation: 枫叶是加拿大的国家象征。
questions.explanation: maple leaf 是加拿大的国旗象征，属于 Canada。

questions.prompt: E. Paris (巴黎)
questions.translation: 巴黎是法国的首都。
questions.explanation: Paris 是法国首都，属于 France。

questions.prompt: F. the Sydney Opera House (悉尼歌剧院)
questions.translation: 悉尼歌剧院位于澳大利亚悉尼。
questions.explanation: the Sydney Opera House 是澳大利亚的地标，属于 Australia。

questions.prompt: G. koala (考拉/树袋熊)
questions.translation: 考拉是澳大利亚特有的国宝动物。
questions.explanation: koala 是澳大利亚特有动物，属于 Australia。

questions.prompt: H. ice hockey (冰球)
questions.translation: 冰球是加拿大的国球运动。
questions.explanation: ice hockey 是加拿大最著名的体育运动，属于 Canada。

questions.prompt: I. the Leaning Tower of Pisa (比萨斜塔)
questions.translation: 比萨斜塔位于意大利比萨城。
questions.explanation: the Leaning Tower of Pisa 是意大利著名古迹，属于 Italy。

questions.prompt: J. Rome (罗马)
questions.translation: 罗马是意大利的首都。
questions.explanation: Rome 是意大利首都，属于 Italy。

questions.prompt: K. kangaroo (袋鼠)
questions.translation: 袋鼠是澳大利亚的标志性动物。
questions.explanation: kangaroo 是澳大利亚特有动物，属于 Australia。

questions.prompt: L. the Louvre Museum (卢浮宫博物馆)
questions.translation: 卢浮宫位于法国巴黎。
questions.explanation: the Louvre Museum 是法国著名博物馆，属于 France。

sections.title: 四、听力判断 (Speed up)
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容判断句子是否与所听到的内容一致,一致的在括号中用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。

audio.text: Anna is a backpacker from Australia. Last spring, she travelled to Yunnan, China alone. It was her first time there. She visited a village and joined the Water-splashing Festival. People were splashing water on each other. At first, Anna thought it was strange. But then a local told her that splashing water brings good luck. So Anna joined them and had a lot of fun. She got very wet but she was happy. She said, "I love this festival! This is the best travel experience I've ever had!"

questions.translation: 安娜独自去了中国云南。
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确指出 'she travelled to Yunnan, China alone.'（alone 与 by herself 同义），故为 T。
questions.prompt: Anna went to Yunnan by herself.

questions.translation: 她在城市里看到了泼水节。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'She visited a village and joined the Water-splashing Festival.'（在村庄里），故为 F。
questions.prompt: She saw the Water-splashing Festival in a city.

questions.translation: 起初安娜觉得这个节日很有趣。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'At first, Anna thought it was strange.'（起初觉得很奇怪），故为 F。
questions.prompt: At first, Anna thought the festival was interesting.

questions.translation: 安娜了解到泼水能带来好运。
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确提到 'splashing water brings good luck'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Anna learned that splashing water can bring good luck.

questions.translation: 安娜在这个节日里玩得很开心。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'So Anna joined them and had a lot of fun.'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Anna had a great time at this festival.

sections.title: 五、完形填空 (Speed up - 汤姆的北京之行)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文,根据短文内容,选择恰当的单词,将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage: My name is Tom. I'm from the UK. Last month, I went to Beijing on a school trip. It was my first time in China. [1] a beautiful city it is! We visited the Great Wall. It is very long and old. I was [2] amazed by its grandeur (宏伟). I took many photos. We also went to the Summer Palace. I tried Beijing duck. It was delicious. I learned to use chopsticks. At first it was hard, but I didn't give up. [3] lucky I am to have this experience! On the last day, we went to a hutong. We [4] a ricksha ride (人力车). It was so much fun. I really enjoyed my trip. I think travelling [5] us see the world.

questions.translation: 多么美丽的一座城市啊！
questions.explanation: 感叹句结构 'What + a/an + adj. + 可数名词单数 + 主语 + 谓语!'，故选 A (What)。

questions.translation: 我对其宏伟壮观感到如此惊叹。
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 amazed 用副词 so，故选 A (so)。

questions.translation: 能有这次经历我是多么幸运啊！
questions.explanation: 感叹句结构 'How + adj. + 主语 + 谓语!'，修饰形容词 lucky 用 How，故选 B (How)。

questions.translation: 我们体验了人力车。
questions.explanation: 叙述过去的旅行经历，动词用一般过去时 took，故选 B (took)。

questions.translation: 我认为旅行帮助我们看世界。
questions.explanation: 宾语从句主语为动名词 travelling，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式 helps，故选 B (helps)。

sections.title: 六、听力填空 (Fuel up - A Great Trip to Italy)
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容补全信息。

audio.text: Hello, I'm Sarah, S-A-R-A-H, Sarah. I'm 17 years old. Last summer, I travelled to Italy. I enjoyed the wonderful view of the Arno River. I walked across Ponte Vecchio, a famous old bridge. I met a pretty girl and we became friends. I really loved my trip.

sections.passage:
# A Great Trip
* **Name:** [1]
* **Age:** [2]
* **What did she do:**
  - enjoyed the wonderful [3] of Arno River
  - visited a famous old [4]
  - made friends with a [5] girl

questions.translation: 姓名：Sarah
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确拼写为 Sarah（S-A-R-A-H）。
questions.prompt: Name

questions.translation: 年龄：17岁
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'I'm 17 years old.'，故填 17 或 seventeen。
questions.prompt: Age

questions.translation: 风景：view
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'I enjoyed the wonderful view of the Arno River.'，故填 view。
questions.prompt: enjoyed the wonderful _____ of Arno River

questions.translation: 老桥：bridge
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'I walked across Ponte Vecchio, a famous old bridge.'，故填 bridge。
questions.prompt: visited a famous old _____

questions.translation: 漂亮的：pretty
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'I met a pretty girl and we became friends.'，故填 pretty。
questions.prompt: made friends with a _____ girl

sections.title: 七、表格阅读填空 (Gift-giving Customs Around the World)
sections.instruction: 请阅读关于“送礼习俗”的文章,根据短文内容,完成表格。
sections.passage:
# Gift-giving Customs Around the World

Gift-giving customs are different around the world. In China, it is polite to refuse (拒绝) a gift two or three times before accepting it. This shows modesty (谦逊). In Japan, people use both hands to give and receive gifts. They do not open gifts in front of the giver. In Western countries like the US and the UK, people usually open gifts right away and say "Thank you". In India, gifts are often given with the right hand only. The left hand is considered (认为) unclean. In many countries, giving a clock as a gift is unlucky because it sounds like "attending a funeral" (出席葬礼) in some languages. Learning these customs can help you avoid embarrassment (尴尬) and show respect.

---

### Summary of Customs
* **China:** [1] before accepting it
* **Japan:** use [2] hands
* **the US / UK:** open gifts [3] and say "Thank you!"
* **India:** use the [4] hand only
* **Many countries:** Giving a clock is [5]

questions.translation: 拒绝：refuse
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'In China, it is polite to refuse a gift two or three times before accepting it.' 可知填 refuse。
questions.prompt: China: _____ before accepting it

questions.translation: 双手：both (或 two)
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'In Japan, people use both hands to give and receive gifts.' 可知填 both (或 two)。
questions.prompt: Japan: use _____ hands

questions.translation: 立刻：right away
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'In Western countries like the US and the UK, people usually open gifts right away' 可知填 right away。
questions.prompt: the US / UK: open gifts _____ and say "Thank you!"

questions.translation: 右手：right
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'In India, gifts are often given with the right hand only.' 可知填 right。
questions.prompt: India: use the _____ hand only

questions.translation: 不吉利的：unlucky
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'In many countries, giving a clock as a gift is unlucky' 可知填 unlucky。
questions.prompt: Many countries: Giving a clock is _____

sections.title: 八、阅读理解 A (Qingdao A Beautiful Coastal City)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面介绍家乡的文章,根据文章内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# Qingdao A Beautiful Coastal City

My hometown is Qingdao, sitting in the east of Shandong Province beside the Yellow Sea, on eastern China's coast. It is famous for the blue sea, golden beaches, and fresh seafood. Every summer, many tourists come here to swim and play on the sand.

Qingdao has a long history. You can see old German-style buildings near the sea. The most famous one is the Zhanqiao Pier. Another nice place is Badaguan, an area with old villas (西式洋房建筑).

The best way to get around is by bus or subway. You can also ride a bike along the coast. Qingdao is also famous for Tsingtao Beer. Every August, the city holds the Beer Festival. People from all over the world come to enjoy beer and have fun. And the local food is amazing. You can try seafood noodles and grilled clams (烤蛤蜊).

I love my hometown because it is clean, lively, and full of nice people. How lucky I am to live here!

questions.translation: 青岛在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段 'sitting in the east of Shandong Province... on eastern China's coast.' 可知青岛位于中国东部，故选 A。
questions.prompt: Where is Qingdao?

questions.translation: 青岛以什么闻名？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段 'It is famous for the blue sea, golden beaches, and fresh seafood.' 可知以碧海、金滩和新鲜海鲜闻名，故选 C。
questions.prompt: What is Qingdao famous for?
options: Blue sea, golden beaches and fresh seafood.

questions.translation: 在青岛你能看到什么样的历史建筑？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段 'You can see old German-style buildings near the sea.' 可知能看到古老的德式建筑，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What historical buildings can you see in Qingdao?

questions.translation: 青岛啤酒节在什么时候举行？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段 'Every August, the city holds the Beer Festival.' 可知每年八月举行，故选 B。
questions.prompt: When is the Beer Festival held in Qingdao?

questions.translation: 作者觉得自己的家乡怎么样？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段 'I love my hometown because it is clean, lively, and full of nice people.' 可知干净且充满活力，故选 C。
questions.prompt: What does the writer think of his hometown?
options: It is too small and boring.

sections.title: 九、阅读理解 B (Ibn Battuta)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文,根据短文内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# Ibn Battuta

Ibn Battuta was a great traveller from Morocco (摩洛哥), a country in North Africa. He lived about 600 years ago. When he was 21 years old, he wanted to travel to Mecca (麦加) for a journey. But he didn't stop there. He continued travelling for nearly thirty years and visited more than forty countries. He went to many places, including China, India, and Spain. He travelled by ship, by camel, and on foot. He faced many dangers like pirates (海盗), deserts, and illnesses. But he never gave up.

Ibn Battuta kept diaries of his journeys. He wrote about the food, clothes, and customs of different cultures. In China, he was amazed by the paper money. At that time, many other countries did not use it. He also wrote about the beautiful Chinese cities, their busy markets, and the friendly people.

His book, called *The Rihla* (《游记》), helps us learn what the world was like hundreds of years ago. Like Zhang Qian and Marco Polo, Ibn Battuta was a bridge between different cultures. His stories still inspire travellers today.

questions.translation: 伊本·白图泰来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段第一句 'Ibn Battuta was a great traveller from Morocco' 可知来自摩洛哥，故选 C。
questions.prompt: Where was Ibn Battuta from?

questions.translation: 伊本·白图泰旅行了多长时间？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段 'He continued travelling for nearly thirty years' 可知旅行了将近30年，故选 B。
questions.prompt: How long did Ibn Battuta travel?

questions.translation: 在中国什么让伊本·白图泰感到惊奇？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段 'In China, he was amazed by the paper money.' 可知是中国使用的纸币，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What surprised Ibn Battuta in China?

questions.translation: 伊本·白图泰的重要意义是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段 'Like Zhang Qian and Marco Polo, Ibn Battuta was a bridge between different cultures.' 可知他搭建了不同文化交流的桥梁，故选 C。
questions.prompt: What is the importance of Ibn Battuta?
